description: Composite, STEM, and ELA scores from the four ACT section scores, each clamped to 1 to 36 exactly as the page does. The composite is the rounded average of the four sections. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive ACT Score calculator.
